reviews.text: This is the easiest review I’ve ever written. We decided on getting a pool enclosure a few months back. When I reached out to Adam’s the price was right and the design looked awesome on paper. Fast forward to this past weekend and the paper drawings became a reality. It’s like adding a room to your home. It’s only been in place for two days but we’ve already spent more time in it in those two days than we normally spend out there in a week because the bugs are GONE! Thank you Ryan and thank you Adam’s for making this a reality.
reviews.author: Danny Relfe

reviews.text: Great experience working with Adams Aluminum for my new pool enclosure.  They helped significantly with the design and provided technical information to the design engineer to meet our local code requirements.  The construction crew was absolutely outstanding; explained exactly what they were doing and why.  I love my new enclosure.  I highly recommend Adams Aluminum.
reviews.author: A H

reviews.text: So happy with Adam’s Aluminum. Everyone was great to work with, including the installation crew. Couldn’t have asked for more. If you’re looking for a pool enclosure I highly recommend this company.
reviews.author: Lisa Davis

reviews.text:
We are over joyed with our new pool enclosure! The crew was absolutely amazing to work with and so very polite. We love dealing with the company on anything we need or have questions about.
We recommend Adams Aluminum for any of your screened in needs. Thank you so much!
reviews.author: Amanda Carter

reviews.text: We wanted to totally remodel our outdoor pool and patio area as well as keep out bees, mosquitoes, deer flies, sand flies, knats AND rain. We decided that an enclosure with a polycarbonate roof was the only answer for us to enjoy our pool/patio regardless of the time of day, night, rain or shine. Adams Aluminum' staff and crews made our dream into a reality. Everyone involved worked hard, very polite and professional. Excellent work and a job well done!
reviews.author: Sonny Adams

reviews.text: Want to thank Robert and all of the people who make up Adams Aluminum for one of the best Christmas presents I ever received - my brand new pool enclosure ! You may have heard that old saying, good things come to those who wait, well, I’m here to tell you that it couldn’t be more true ! Yes, we had to patiently wait, but it was well worth it ! Robert said he would do it, said we would love it and Robert came through ! If you or someone you know is looking for a product superior to the rest, built by a very professional and reputable company that won’t settle for less than doing their best, I recommend Adams Aluminum, my wife and I are so glad we waited and we’re sure you will be, too ! Thank you, Robert for building us such a beautiful pool enclosure that me and my family will enjoy for years to come ! We know coming back from Hurricane Ida has been rough for all of us and we can only imagine how hard it’s been for you and Adams Aluminun… I want you and anyone viewing this review who may be going through a difficult time to remember there is hope, Be of a good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the Lord. Psalm 31:24 Be encouraged !

reviews.text: Adams aluminum installed a screened enclosure over our pool and outdoor kitchen.  While we had to be patient (almost a year wait) due to Covid, hurricanes, and life in general, the final product was well worth the wait.  The guys were professional, cleaned up daily, and our contact was responsive and helpful from the design phase to the finish.  This enclosure is one of the best decisions we've made as homeowners. Their prices were fair, and I would use them again.
reviews.author: Darce Richmond

reviews.text: We had our back patio screened in. The entire process was seamless and so easy. Ryan takes a personal interest in the quality of their work. The framers were kind and respected our property. The quality is great as well. Not a single mosquito in site!
